bio: ‘A backstreet Italian eatery’ is how this trattoria bills itself. The chef professes his love of Tuscany through his cooking, which includes crostini of chicken-liver paste; beef tripe simmered in the Florentine style; Pici, akin to a thick spaghetti, in tomato ragú is a Sienese primo piatto. The meat elegantly grilled over charcoal flame is best enjoyed with a bottle of red wine....
